doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Nandish H K is currently working as senior consultant gastroenterologist at nh hospitals, bengaluru. He obtained his md in internal medicine from kempegowda institiute of medical sciences, bengaluru and dnb (gastroenterology) from prestigious amrita institute of medical science. He also has post - doctoral fellowship in advanced therapeutic endoscopy and endoscopic ultrasound from amrita institute of medical sciences, kochi. Dr. Nandish H K is an expert in the diagnosis and management of various gastrointestinal and liver diseases as well in performing various diagnostic and advanced endoscopic therapeutic procedures. He has a keen interest and expertise in pancreaticobiliary interventions including ercp, eus and cholangioscopy as well in image- enchanced endoscopy. Dr. Nandish H K has a number of papers and publications to his credit including award paper presentation in national conferences and peer reviewed journals.
